title: Do Your Best! Urara's True Grit

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hup! Hup!
...Aaaand goooaaal!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, looking good!
All right, one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hup! Hup! Hup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final training day of Tracen Academy's summer training camp.
Haru Urara threw herself into training with all her might again today.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Urara-san is full of energy as always.
She's shining even brighter than the seaside sun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The reporter who had become a fan of Haru Urara was covering the training camp, snapping photos of her running.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to stay and watch longer, but I have my next assignment, so I'll be off.
I'll send the digital photos over to you later!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training went on all day long.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
I'm so tiiiired! But I gave it everything I gooooot!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! After doing all that, I must've gotten faster, right?!
Right, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Why are you going quiet?!
What was my time on that last lap?!
choice_data_list: You... didn't beat your personal best.
You... didn't beat your personal best.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Uuuu~! Bummer...!
Well then, this next one'll really be the last one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*grumble...*)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oops.
...Ehehe! My tummy's growling!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mmm-mmm, festival food is the best~!
Crepes, castella cake, and carrot candy♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To reward Haru Urara for working her hardest at camp and to recharge her batteries, we visited a nearby summer festival.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything you wanna eat, Trainer, just say the word!
I'll dash right over and buy it for you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Festivals are so much fun!
Thanks for bringing me along, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe♪ Ah! Hey, look over there!
They have a ring toss! That brings back memories!

text_block_list.name: Farmer
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, mister! You came here to have fun too!
!

text_block_list.name: Farmer
text_block_list.text:
Taking a break from training camp, Urara-chan?
How're you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Umm... I ran a whole bunch and had super lots of fun!

text_block_list.name: Farmer
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? That's what matters most!
I'm looking forward to your races after summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm definitely taking first place next time,
so make sure you come cheer for me again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After parting ways with the familiar local...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Hey, Trainer!
Can we do just one more thing, pretty please?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Haru Urara's request,
we made our way to the beach at night.
choice_data_list: Did you need something at the beach?
Got some business at the beach?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I really wanted to get in just one last run before we leave!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I worked super hard, after all,
so I wanna finish camp knowing I got faster!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Time me, okay, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara took her starting position with an uncharacteristic seriousness.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ready whenever you are!
Give me the signal!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hup-two, hup-two, hup-two, hup-two!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Gooooaaal!
*pant* *pant*... How was my time?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Auuuughhh!
I couldn't beat itttt!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Once we're back at the academy, I'm gonna try way, way, waaaay harder,
get faster, and definitely, absolutely take first place!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara shouts at the open ocean.
In her own way, she is deeply frustrated by the lack of visible progress.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if she hasn't noticed it herself, the results of her training are undeniably there.
To show her, I pull out my phone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I show Haru Urara two photos the reporter sent me.
One from when we first met her, and one from today.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's me!
What about them?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huhhh?! Nobody's ever called me beautiful before!
W-What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The difference between the two photos is her running form.
She has steadily developed a far more efficient stride.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she keeps going like this, her times will surely begin to drop.
I explain this to Haru Urara.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Really? Am I really, truly getting better at running?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I trust you! I totally trust you!
Oh, yay! I really am growing!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I knew it! I'm so, so glad you became my Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I always believed I could win first place,
but now, I believe it double-super-definitely!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna give it everything I've got once we're back at school, too!
I'm counting on you, Trainer!
